title: ServerlessWsgiPlugin
description: Schema for the serverless-wsgi plugin (https://github.com/logandk/serverless-wsgi). Goes under `custom.wsgi`.

app.description: Module path of the WSGI application callable (e.g. `app.application`).

pythonBin.description: Python binary used for packaging and serving (e.g. `python3.11`). Defaults to the configured Lambda runtime.

pipArgs.description: Extra arguments forwarded to `pip` during requirement installation.

textMimeTypes.description: Additional MIME types to send as plain text instead of base64-encoded. Adds to the default allow list.
